# redis-cluster-kubernetes-operator

> Kubernetes operator that creates and manages Redis Cluster (sharded, hash slots) from a RedisCluster custom resource: topology, failover, resharding, blue/green pod rollouts and backups. Namespace-scoped. Beta: Redis 8.6 on Kubernetes 1.33.

Agents setting up or checking a cluster should follow the skills; they use the scripts below and report JSON results. Work from a clone of https://github.com/DataDog/redis-cluster-kubernetes-operator. Agents changing this repository's code follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) instead.

## Guardrails

- Show `kubectl config current-context` and get the user's confirmation before applying anything to a non-local cluster; never switch context.
- Never delete RedisClusters, PVCs, StatefulSets or namespaces; never edit `status`.
- Tell the user before a pod-template change: it starts a blue/green rollout that doubles pods.
- Act on each failing check's `fix` from `--json` output instead of guessing.

## Agent skills

- [Set up the operator and a cluster](skills/redis-cluster-setup/SKILL.md): confirm target, preflight, install, size, create, verify
- [Health check](skills/redis-cluster-health/SKILL.md): read-only report for every RedisCluster
- [Claude Code plugin](skills/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): install with `/plugin marketplace add DataDog/redis-cluster-kubernetes-operator`

## Scripts

- [scripts/preflight.sh](scripts/preflight.sh): is this Kubernetes cluster ready for the operator (`--json`)
- [scripts/verify-cluster.sh](scripts/verify-cluster.sh): does a RedisCluster serve traffic (`--json`)
